title: Hot Air Balloons in Sky
description: A person sees many colorful hot air balloons floating in a blue sky with white clouds. The largest yellow balloon is in the center with people visible in its basket, while smaller balloons in red, purple, orange, and striped patterns fill the scene around it.
prompt: A realistic painting of many hot air balloons floating in a bright blue sky with white clouds. A very large yellow balloon with orange bottom dominates the center with visible people in its wooden basket, surrounded by smaller balloons in red, purple, striped orange yellow white gray, and other colors, all drifting peacefully at different heights.
